in_arabic.name: حنيف
in_arabic.meaning: حنيف يعني منحنيا عن الشرك و ملتفتا إلى الله
in_arabic.long_meaning: حنيف هو اسم مشتق من الحنيفية، وهي ملة الإسلام الحق التي جاء بها سيدنا إبراهيم عليه السلام، وتعني الانحناء عن الشرك و التوحيد لله وحده، و هو من الأسماء التي وردت في القرآن الكريم

in_urdu.name: حنیف
in_urdu.meaning: حنیف کا مطلب ہے سیدھا راستہ، اللہ کی طرف مائل
in_urdu.long_meaning: حنیف نام کا مطلب ہے سیدھا راستہ، جو اللہ کی طرف مائل ہو، یہ نام سورة آل عمران میں ذکر ہوا ہے، اور یہ نام حضرت ابراہیم علیہ السلام کی سنت سے ماخوذ ہے

in_hindi.name: हनीफ
in_hindi.meaning: हनीफ का अर्थ है सीधा रास्ता, ईश्वर की ओर झुका हुआ
in_hindi.long_meaning: हनीफ नाम का अर्थ है सीधा रास्ता, जो ईश्वर की ओर झुका हुआ हो, यह नाम कुरआन में सूरत आल इमरान में आया है, और यह नाम हज़रत इब्राहिम अलैहिस्सलाम की सुन्नत से लिया गया है

in_pashto.name: حنيف

in_english.name: Haneef
in_english.meaning: upright, inclined to Allah, true in religion

In the Arabic language, the name Haneef means "free from sin," which is a desirable characteristic in Islamic society. This name carries a positive connotation and is often associated with moral excellence, integrity, and a strong sense of justice. Individuals bearing the name Haneef are often perceived as virtuous and noble, reflecting the ideals of compassion, kindness, and generosity that are deeply valued in Islamic teachings.

In Islamic theology, being free from sin is a prerequisite for entering the presence of God. The name Haneef can be seen as a reminder of the significance of living a life in accordance with divine guidance, striving towards moral excellence, and seeking God's pleasure above all else. It also carries a deeper metaphysical meaning, suggesting a soul that is purified and refined through spiritual practices and a constant striving towards inner growth and self-improvement. Ultimately, the name Haneef represents a noble and virtuous character that is pleasing to both the human community and the divine Creator.
